inputs.price_source: Yahoo Finance chart API ECOR.L regularMarketPrice 151.2 GBp at 2026-10-27 14:02 UTC, times GBPUSD=X 1.3327 at 2026-10-27 14:20 UTC, divided by 100. 151.2/100*1.3327 = 2.0150424, stored as 2.015 USD. OTCQX ECRAF 1.98 USD on 2026-10-26 is a different line and is not the model price.
inputs.fcf_source: Company-defined free cash flow of 27.4 million USD for the year ended 2025-12-31, divided by weighted average shares of 248,944 thousand. Source: Ecora Royalties PLC FY2025 results, 26 March 2026, https://www.ecoraroyalties.com/application/files/6617/7451/2259/Ecora_Royalties_FY_25_Results.pdf. Definition in that release: net cash from operating activities, plus Denison principal repayments and finance income, less finance costs and lease payments. Ending share count was not printed in that release.
inputs.normalization_note: Finance costs are already deducted in the company free cash flow figure, so net debt of 85.5 million USD is not deducted again. Growth is set to zero because the Kestrel decline and base-metals growth are not netted into a forecast.

bear.notes: [Assumption] Kestrel volumes fall faster than base metals grow.

base.notes: [Assumption] Flat company free cash flow and a 12 times selling multiple.

bull.notes: [Assumption] Base metals more than replace Kestrel.

evidence: Ecora Royalties PLC FY2025 results PDF, 26 March 2026.
